title: Tab and shift+tab switch views; left/right and 1-9 switch projects

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Decided 2026-10-20 (decision 120, ui.views): Tab and shift+tab switch views (Overview, Roadmap, Decisions); left, right and 1-9 switch projects.

Today tab and shift+tab move between projects. That is the S57 binding (internal/tui/keys.go:35-36), so the views cannot be reached by keys. The view bar is static text (internal/tui/view.go:168-171), and the help says only Overview exists (view.go:197).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/keys.go`: keyMap struct (:8-26) gains NextView and PrevView; newKeyMap (:28-48): Next (:35) becomes right only, Prev (:36) left only; FullHelp (:54-56) gets a view group.
- `internal/tui/model.go`: Model struct (:93-115) gains view int; key() dispatch (:353-356) gains the two view cases; a new moveView.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: viewBar (:168-171) and helpLines (:187-199, text at :197). The bar becomes the five-view list of record 121 (Overview, Questions, Waves, Roadmap, Decisions), so almost every golden changes by that one word.
- `internal/tui/tui_test.go`: TestTabKeysSwitchTheProject (:262-287), TestRefreshKeyRefreshesTheVisibleProjectNow (:336), TestProjectKeysResetTheRowCursor (:598-604), TestNavigationKeysDoWhatTheHelpSays (:638-673), help list in TestHelpKeyTogglesTheHelp (:314), TestDashboardDocsListTheNavigationKeys (:698-715).
- `internal/tui/sidebar_test.go`: TestSidebarNavigationFilterAndHide (:44-54), TestSidebarScrollAndCompactNames (:97), TestFilterKeepsActiveProject (:226, shift+tab moves the project today).
- `internal/tui/live_test.go:125`: the tab that switches project becomes right.
- `internal/tui/actions_test.go:198`: help list.
- `testdata/golden/action-help-mono-true.txt` and action-help-mono-false.txt (lines 5-6 list the keys).
- `docs/dashboard.md`: lines 58-62 (project keys) and the view bar at line 28 and :183 (add Questions, record 121); line 40 says only Overview is selectable and stays true until the next view lands.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- tab and shift+tab leave the project and the row cursor where they are, and the bar still shows Overview (new TestViewKeysDoNotMoveTheProject; it fails today because tab moves the project).
- With only Overview built, tab and shift+tab do nothing and set no message. Views not built are skipped (record 121).
- right and left move projects; 1-9 jump; n and p still move rows (TestTabKeysSwitchTheProject rewritten with right and left).
- With the filter box open, tab and shift+tab type nothing and move nothing; the answer field takes them as text (extend TestFilterBoxTakesRowKeysAsText and TestAnswerFieldTakesRowKeysAsText).
- The help lists "right next project", "left previous project", "tab next view" and "shift+tab previous view" (TestHelpKeyTogglesTheHelp, TestActionHelp, and the two action-help goldens).
- docs/dashboard.md lists the new keys (TestDashboardDocsListTheNavigationKeys rewritten).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Decided: record 120 (tab and shift+tab switch views; left, right and 1-9 switch projects) and record 121 (ui.view-list: Overview, Questions, Waves, Roadmap, Decisions, in that order; tab and shift+tab skip views that are not built yet, and the bar shows those dim).
1. Write the tests first: a new TestViewKeysDoNotMoveTheProject in internal/tui/tui_test.go (four projects; tab and shift+tab leave active and cursor alone). Run go test ./internal/tui -run TestViewKeys and watch it fail: tab moves the project today (keys.go:35).
2. Rewrite the stale tests in the Files list: project moves use right and left; the help and docs wording uses the new labels.
3. keys.go: add NextView (key "tab", help "tab", "next view") and PrevView (key "shift+tab", help "shift+tab", "previous view") to keyMap (:8-26) and newKeyMap (:28-48). Change Next (:35) to key "right", help "right", "next project"; Prev (:36) to key "left", help "left", "previous project".
4. keys.go FullHelp (:54-56): first group {k.NextView, k.PrevView}, then {k.Next, k.Prev, k.Jump}.
5. view.go: add a views list beside viewBar (:166-171): Overview, Questions, Waves, Roadmap, Decisions, each with a built flag (only Overview is built in this slice). viewBar marks the active view and draws unbuilt views dim, as today. The bar gains the word Questions (second place), so every golden that shows the bar changes; review those diffs for that one word only.
6. model.go Model (:93-115): add view int. key() (:353-356): add case key.Matches(msg, m.keys.NextView): m.moveView(1) and case key.Matches(msg, m.keys.PrevView): m.moveView(-1), both returning nil.
7. model.go: moveView(delta) steps to the next built view in that direction, wrapping, and does nothing when only one view is built. Later slices (S27, S12, S59, S60) set their view's built flag when they land.
8. Update docs/dashboard.md lines 58-62: project keys are right and left, 1-9; tab and shift+tab switch views. Update the view bar line 28 and the later mention at :183 to the five-view list.
9. Mutation-check: map tab back to Next and confirm TestViewKeysDoNotMoveTheProject goes red.
10. Regenerate the goldens: go test ./internal/tui -update; review testdata/golden/action-help-mono-true.txt and -false.txt, and every golden whose view bar now has Questions.
Open: with the pane open, paneKey (internal/tui/pane.go:48-84) takes the keys, so tab does nothing there. The draft keeps that; the owner can veto.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review testdata/golden/action-help-mono-true.txt and action-help-mono-false.txt by eye; nothing else should change.
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui again, so the goldens pass.
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check (docs/dashboard.md)
- adj lint
- Run by name: TestViewKeysDoNotMoveTheProject, TestTabKeysSwitchTheProject, TestNavigationKeysDoWhatTheHelpSays, TestFilterBoxTakesRowKeysAsText, TestDashboardDocsListTheNavigationKeys, TestLayoutHasTabsViewBarBodyAndStatusLine (must still pass unless the Waves answer changes the bar).
